name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, property, or command
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that is hard or impossible today? Describe the
operational situation rather than the solution.

## Proposal

How should it work? If it is a configuration property, suggest a name under
`jss.*` (project extensions) or explain which existing `wrapper.*` property it
completes, plus its default value and its behaviour when misconfigured.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to reach the same result, and why they fall short.

## Compatibility

- Does it change the behaviour of an existing `wrapper.conf`? How?
- Does it affect the log format, the command line, or the EXE-to-JAR protocol?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and `docs/compatibility.md`.
- [ ] The proposal is described in my own words and does not rely on material
      from third-party source code or documentation.
